declaration.preface: Permeshwar Creations is a renowned apparel manufacturing company in India, known for its commitment to quality, innovation, and sustainability. At Permeshwar Creations, we pride ourselves on being a leader in the apparel manufacturing industry. Since our inception, we have been dedicated to producing high-quality garments that meet the needs of our diverse clientele. Our research and development team continuously innovate, creating lightweight, fine-textured garments in a variety of beautiful colors and designs.
declaration.declaration:
Permeshwar Creations is committed to conducting business ethically and with integrity. We strive to prevent any form of corruption and ensure responsible management of information.

Below are our commitments and targets towards equal opportunity as compared to baseline year 2022.
declaration.scope: This policy comprehensively covers all aspects of Permeshwar Creation Pvt. Ltd.’s manufacturing and operation sites. It applies to all workers, employees, suppliers, and stakeholders, both internal and external, associated directly or indirectly with Permeshwar Creation Pvt. Ltd.

focusAreas: Diversity, Inclusion, Equal Opportunities, Discrimination, and Harassment

Workplace Safety and Health: Ensure safety at work through comprehensive safety protocols.
Promote physical and psychological health at work.
We aim to provide comprehensive health and safety training to our employees for better working practices.
We will cultivate a culture of “zero harm” where all employees are empowered to report unsafe conditions without fear of reprisal.
Work-Life Balance and Well-being: Respect the right to disconnect after work hours.
Provide competitive remuneration and social benefits.
Aim to provide our employees with a health insurance program and conduct regular employee health check-ups.
We will promote a workplace culture where mental health and well-being are openly discussed and supported.
Employee Engagement and Communication: Foster structured social dialogue through recognized employee representatives.
We will maintain transparent and two-way communication channels (town halls, newsletters, digital platforms) for employees across all levels.
Career Development and Advancement: Ensure fair recruitment, evaluation, and promotion processes.
Facilitate training and career development opportunities for all employees.
We will build a culture of continuous learning by integrating mentorship and coaching programs into career development plans.
Labor Rights Compliance: Maintain zero tolerance for any incidents related to child labor, forced labor, or human trafficking.
Provide training to employees on child labor, forced labor, and human trafficking.
Conduct regular internal assessments on labor exploitation.
Prohibit child labor, forced labor, and human trafficking in all company operations.
We will foster an ethical workplace culture where respect for human rights is a shared responsibility at every level.
Foster an ethical workplace culture where respect for human rights is a shared responsibility at every level.
Diversity, Inclusion, Equal Opportunitie: Foster a zero-tolerance culture for discrimination and harassment.
Prevent discrimination, harassment, and abuse in the workplace.
Promote equal treatment and opportunities for employees from diverse backgrounds.
Promote open communication channels for reporting incidents without fear of retaliation.
We will strengthen an inclusive culture where employees feel valued, respected, and empowered to contribute fully.
Ethical Supply Chain Practices: Ensure suppliers adhere to ethical labor practices and human rights standards.
Conduct regular audits and assessments of supply chain partners.
We will prioritize long-term partnerships with suppliers who share our values on fairness, ethics, and human rights.
Community Engagement and Social Impact: Support local communities through sustainable initiatives.
Mitigate negative social impacts of business operations.
We will build meaningful partnerships with NGOs, schools, and local organizations to create a positive and lasting social impact.

Conduct biannual meetings with employee representatives with an attendance rate of 90%
We aim to include 100% of employees in the collective bargaining agreement
We will achieve at least 85% employee participation in annual engagement surveys
Increase employee participation in professional development programs by 15% annually
We will ensure at least 80% of employees complete one skills enhancement training annually
0% tolerance for any incidents related to child labor, forced labor, or human trafficking
By 2028, we will conduct annual third-party audits to verify compliance with labor rights standards across all facilities
Maintain zero reported cases related to child labor, forced labor, and human trafficking

responsibilities.role: Every employee, director, officer, contractor, and agent of Parmeshwar Creations
responsibilities.duty: The responsibility for implementing and upholding this Equal Opportunity Policy lies with every employee, director, officer, contractor, and agent of Parmeshwar Creations.
Demonstrate visible commitment to equal opportunity and non-discrimination.
Ensure that business decisions, recruitment, promotions, and other employment practices are free from bias.
Allocate necessary resources to support equal opportunity initiatives and programs.
Review and update this policy annually to ensure alignment with legal requirements and best practices.
Monitor implementation effectiveness and recommend improvements.
Oversee overall compliance with equal opportunity and non-discrimination standards across the organization.
Lead the execution of this policy across all levels of the organization.
Develop, implement, and monitor equal opportunity practices, including recruitment, training, and promotions.
Provide regular training and awareness programs on diversity, inclusion, and fair treatment.
Establish reporting and grievance mechanisms for addressing concerns of discrimination or bias.
Ensure fair and consistent treatment of employees within their teams.
Integrate equal opportunity principles into daily operations, decision-making, and performance management.
Encourage open communication and report any breaches of this policy to HR.
Comply with the principles of equal opportunity in their daily conduct and workplace interactions.
Treat colleagues, clients, and stakeholders with fairness, dignity, and respect.
Report any observed discrimination, harassment, or unfair treatment through the appropriate reporting channels.

policy.monitoring: Regular audits and reporting will ensure ongoing compliance with the policy's objectives and principles.
policy.reviewMechanism: This policy will undergo annual reviews overseen by the Chief Human Resources Officer, with the next review scheduled for 1st January 2026. Updates or amendments will be communicated to all stakeholders accordingly.
